title: AFI.------EXP.INFO.B.
description: Second diagram on page 500 (TRF(II)-36), paired with SPT-DY × AF-POST above. The crossing diagrams how affinity-insight structurally meets expansion-information-basis at the alternative-spiritual-affinity-alignment scale the prior diagram named: AFI (affinity insight) crossed with EXP-INFO-B (expansion information basis). AFI sits at center-left with the subject-arrow; EXP-INFO-B sits at center-right as partner-axis. TR (transformation) rises from the main line to the upper right and carries OP-SD (option spread), which carries SOC-RT-DY (social-reality dynamics). SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics) drops from the main line to the lower right and carries IST-S-ALGN (isolated systematic alignment), which carries MT-INFO (multi-information). (R)TM (the reality of terminology, or terms of a definition) drops from the main line to the lower left and carries CULT-AF-B (culture affinity basis), which carries POST (postulation).
